title: The journal's tool only appends
situation: The architect restated the concepts as name and differentia and cut implementation from them; this behaviour, which the concepts carried before, is recorded here so it stays bound.
decision: The concept journal's tool offers readings and appending verbs only: every change to the design, a correction or a settlement included, is a new entry, and no verb edits, rewrites or removes one already recorded.
consequences: The journal is append-only by its verbs; its history is controlled by code review, never by refusal.
